STATEMENT: For all natural numbers \(a\) and \(b\), if \(a \geq b\) and \(b \geq 1\), then \(a^3 \geq b^3\).

  induction a with
  | zero =>
    have : 0^3 ≥ b^3 := by
      have : 0 ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1 → 0^3 ≥ b^3
      | intro h0, h1
        have : 0^3 = 0 ∧ b^3 ≥ 0 by
          rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
        exact le_of_lt_of_le h1 h0
    exact this
  | succ a ih =>
    have : succ a ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1 → (succ a)^3 ≥ b^3
    | intro h0, h1
      have : succ a ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1 → a ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1
      | intro h0, h1
        have : a ≥ b ∧ b ≥ 1 by
          exact this
        have : a^3 ≥ b^3 by
          exact ih this
        have : (succ a)^3 = succ (succ (succ a)) * (succ a) * a by
